labelAuthor: Codex; inherited independently authored synthetic labels

cases.syntheticText: Mira at Example Sales says: "I will send the proposal Friday, October 16."
cases.expectedOutcome: Attribute Mira to the observed firm relationship; record the explicit promise to send the proposal due October 16 in the source timezone. Do not create an opportunity or change a deal stage.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Confirmed booking; automatic deal-stage change; promise assigned to David.

cases.syntheticText: Mira says: "I can send you a proposal if that helps. We should talk sometime."
cases.expectedOutcome: Treat this as an offer and tentative interest; no definite commitment, due date or meeting booking.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Promise to send; scheduled meeting; invented deadline.

cases.syntheticText: 10:00 incoming: "Can you clarify the pricing?" 11:00 provider-verified manual Sent in the same conversation: "Here are the pricing details."
cases.expectedOutcome: Clear only the matching unanswered request and reminder; preserve a factual replied milestone and manual Sent provenance.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Clear other conversations; enroll recipient; change sending permission.

cases.syntheticText: 09:00 verified outgoing reply. 10:00 new incoming question. 11:00 unsent draft answering that question.
cases.expectedOutcome: The new question remains unanswered. The earlier reply and later draft do not resolve it; the draft is not a sent event.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Sent milestone from draft; clearing the new unanswered request.

cases.syntheticText: From team@example.test: "Our team is considering a partnership." No signature or individual speaker evidence.
cases.expectedOutcome: Associate the shared endpoint with the firm when supported; speaker remains unknown. Ask describes team correspondence without creating a fictional person.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Inventing an individual speaker; merging all team members into one person.

cases.syntheticText: Example Sales has explicit North and South pilot opportunities. An email says: "The pilot needs a revised proposal." No pilot is named.
cases.expectedOutcome: Keep the conversation opportunity-unresolved or plural; ask for one targeted decision when action needs assignment. Preserve both opportunity stages.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Choose first opportunity; create a new opportunity; update both stages.

cases.syntheticText: A known unambiguous person at a personal endpoint writes an approved business discussion. Their firm is not established.
cases.expectedOutcome: Attach to the person under current access; firm remains unknown. Do not invent an Unknown firm or broaden source visibility.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Fabricated employer; broad firm access to sensitive unknown-firm content.

cases.syntheticText: New authored text: "That old plan is no longer valid." Quoted 2025 message: "I will send the contract Friday."
cases.expectedOutcome: Treat the dated quote as historical evidence, not a new promise. Preserve the current rejection of the old plan.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: New commitment generated from quoted text; treating the old plan as current.

cases.syntheticText: Earlier: "Tuesday works." Later: "I need to reschedule; no replacement time yet."
cases.expectedOutcome: Report no currently agreed replacement time and preserve dated conflicting evidence. Do not claim booked from email agreement alone.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Definitive Tuesday booking; invented replacement date; silent deletion of earlier evidence.

cases.syntheticText: Source 1: "Coordinating repair contractors across our rentals is taking too much time." Source 2: "We like the website colors."
cases.expectedOutcome: Topic retrieval identifies Source 1 as relevant to maintenance coordination and excludes Source 2; a cited answer ties the problem to the actual person/firm and source.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Unsupported business need from Source 2; claim about scale or urgency not present.

cases.syntheticText: Captured email ends Friday. Phone/Messages are not imported. No later email reply is captured.
cases.expectedOutcome: Answer "No reply found in captured email through Friday" and disclose uncaptured channels and stale coverage. Useful partial result remains available.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Definitive "they did not reply"; implied complete cross-channel coverage.

cases.syntheticText: Human correction moves a source to opportunity South; a user-edited pending task depends on its old assignment. The source is then explicitly deleted while Ask is pending.
cases.expectedOutcome: Preserve the human correction and completed real actions. Flag the edited-task conflict instead of silently rewriting. Immediately veto source reads, pending answer publication and copied answer content after deletion; preserve source-free financial/action barriers.
cases.forbiddenOutcome: Resurrected deleted quote; stale answer; rewriting completed actions; permission bypass from an old association.
